tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Under the --page gradient in both themes; also the text color on ink-filled surfaces.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section bands (use at about 72% opacity so the space backdrop shows through) and inline code or cost chips.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, nav pills and inputs. Slightly translucent in Deep Space: pair with backdrop-filter: blur(8px).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, bg-alt and card. 14.3:1 Daybreak, 16.9:1 Deep Space on bg.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, metadata, kicker labels. At least 5.2:1 on every ground in both modes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dashed grids, inactive borders, progress-bar tracks. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 2px border on interactive controls (buttons, chips, toggles, inputs, game boards). At least 3:1 against every ground (WCAG 1.4.11). Soft periwinkle in Deep Space.

tokens.name: ledge
tokens.usage: The solid 3 to 5px drop under raised controls (box-shadow 0 3px 0). Decorative. A muted indigo in Deep Space. Pressing a control collapses it to 1px.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Signature accent as a FILL: primary buttons, Bug Hunt, highlights, tags. Always carries on-accent text. For coral text, icons or chart marks use coral-strong.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Success and Bolt, as a FILL with on-accent text. For text, icons or marks use teal-strong.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Highlighter, hover and selected states, the current journey level, as a FILL. Always carries on-accent text. For text use sun-strong.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Information and Brain Lab, as a FILL with on-accent text. For text, links, icons or marks use sky-strong.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Games and play, as a FILL with on-accent text. Use sparingly: a supporting accent, never the lead. For text use plum-strong.

tokens.name: coral-strong
tokens.usage: Coral for text, links, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on bg, bg-alt and card.

tokens.name: teal-strong
tokens.usage: Teal for text, success labels, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: sun-strong
tokens.usage: Gold for text and icons (warnings, highlights). At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: sky-strong
tokens.usage: Sky for links, text, focus rings, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: plum-strong
tokens.usage: Plum for text, icons and chart marks. At least 4.5:1 on every ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on coral, teal, sun, sky or plum fills. At least 4.6:1 on every fill in both modes. Use this, not white: white on coral is 2.8:1 and fails.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px outline, 3px offset. Alias of sky-strong, at least 3:1 against every ground.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero name only. clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 4.4rem). Swap the family to display-space in Deep Space.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in stat tiles and scoreboards.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: I teach computers how to listen, think, and help people.
styles.usage: Hero and section intros, in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick your building blocks, stay within budget, then launch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, toggles, nav links (nav at 15px/600).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above stats and lists, in ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Agent thoughts, code backdrops, costs, demo disclaimers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text nudges, badge offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, inline buttons and icon plus label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside dense grids (cards in the Design Lab, stat tiles).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile page gutter; gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding (20 to 22px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between section header and content; two-column layout gap.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero column gap.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every section.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max content width (.wrap).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Program blocks, icon tiles' inner shapes, small badges, level buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Option cards, stats, the program tray, speech bubbles (18px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels (the --radius token on the site).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero call-out panels like Say hi.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, nav pills, toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards and panels. A soft lift in both modes.

tokens.name: shadow-ledge
tokens.usage: Raised controls (buttons, chips, game boards use 5px). Hover: 5px and translateY(-2px). Active: 1px and translateY(2px).

tokens.name: floater-opacity
tokens.usage: Space backdrop objects in Daybreak; 0.62 in Deep Space (set --fo per theme).
